question: How much of the exact-unigram still-unseen penalty follows solely from reduced effective prior weight rather than the empirical distribution change?

formula: P(dt)=(count(dt)+(N/5034)/30721)/(N+N/5034). No outcome-dependent adaptation, diagnostic-chosen k, or new source selection.
controls: Reproduce fixed-prior12/35 historical unigram first. Freeze formula/code/sources and normalization tests before any new scoring. Report per-recording/drummer and pooled results even when worse.
